title: Keyboard Manager: Expand dialog interaction tests and improve validation

proposed_comments.title: Enable nullable annotations in the boundary tests

confidence.rationale: An exact-head x64 Debug build reports CS8632 on the three new string? parameters; the test project has no nullable context and the repository treats C# warnings as errors.

proposed_comments.body:
### Enable nullable annotations in the boundary tests

**Severity:** `high`

The new `string?` parameters at lines 62, 79, and 152 cause `CS8632` when building `KeyboardManagerEditorUI.UnitTests`: this project does not enable nullable annotations, and the repository treats C# warnings as errors. As a result, the added unit tests cannot compile under the normal x64 Debug configuration. Enable nullable context for this file so the annotations remain meaningful without changing the project's other tests.

```suggestion
#nullable enable

using System.Collections.Generic;
```
